items.name: General Data Protection Regulation (as applied to support tickets)
items.scope: Support tickets often contain personal data and are a common channel through which EU/EEA individuals exercise data subject access/erasure requests.
items.notes: Applies whenever a support product's customers include EU/EEA individuals; the support team is frequently the first point of contact for a data subject request, whether or not the product itself was built for that purpose.

items.name: Telemarketing Sales Rule (16 CFR 310)
items.scope: Governs outbound/inbound telemarketing calls: required disclosures, do-not-call handling, and call-time restrictions relevant to a voice support channel.
items.notes: Primarily targets telemarketing/sales calls rather than inbound customer support, but call-recording consent and do-not-call list obligations can still apply depending on how the voice channel is used.
